project.name: frappe-framework-core
project.system_context: Asynchronous network gateway, concurrent metadata registry, and content-addressed storage core. Target Stack: Tokio 1.52.3, Actix-Web 4.13.0, SurrealDB 3.0.5, Pasetors 0.7.8, Quiche 0.29.0, Simd-JSON 0.14.
project.directory_structure: frappe-framework/ ├── Cargo.toml └── crates/ ├── frappe-net/ # Web, Routing, Auth, and UDP QUIC Gateway │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── h3_server.rs │ ├── routes.rs │ └── middleware/ │ ├── tenant.rs │ └── auth.rs ├── frappe-meta/ # SIMD-JSON Metadata registry & SurrealQL compiler │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── schema.rs │ └── registry.rs └── frappe-storage/ # Content-addressable file storage engine └── src/ ├── lib.rs └── local_fs.rs

key_invariants.invariant: The quiche::h3::Connection is stateful and is persisted across UDP packets in the HashMap inside ConnectionState. Do not reconstruct on every poll.
Token validation uses pasetors::local::decrypt matching SymmetricKey<V4> keys. Ephemeral fallback keys must be filled, not reassigned, to prevent compiler warnings.
Local FS operations validate bounds using canonicalized directories to prevent traversal breakout.
